sermon.title: How do you serve the Lord? 🤲 - November 5, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: In the series on serving God in every season, the message asks how we serve when the miracles stop. Joshua chose to serve the Lord, Solomon neglected his relationship, Mary chose the good part, and those Jesus healed were told to go home, serve and sin no more. It calls for daily bread, wisdom to build our homes, love in marriage, forgiving ourselves and others, and passing on Christlike character.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. faqs.answer: Fearing and trembling, she fell down and told Him the whole truth.

faqs.question: What practical knowledge does he mention?
faqs.answer: Good financial principles, how to solve problems, how to make a meal.

faqs.question: What does he tell men?
faqs.answer: Men who are not providing and not working hard; it’s all scriptural.

faqs.question: What happens when feelings change in marriage?
faqs.answer: What’s left is being responsible to one another; will you serve each other or get bored of each other?

faqs.question: What would Jesus tell people in encampments?
faqs.answer: He says Jesus would say I’ve healed you, now sin no more; get rid of the drugs.

faqs.answer: He asks; regardless, Jesus went as His custom was on the Sabbath.
